documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for For Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Both Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company Along With The Limited Review Report For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record operational and financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time. The company achieved substantial growth driven by the commissioning of its new Alu-Zinc coating line, augmentation of existing colour-coated capacity, and increased demand from infrastructure and housing sectors. Management highlighted improved operating leverage, enhanced capital efficiency, and a strengthened, conservative balance sheet with no long-term debt. Additionally, the company announced future expansion plans including a new colour-coated line and a cold-rolling mill to deepen backward integration and support long-term revenue targets. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its annual report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting strategic capital expenditure and capacity expansion initiatives funded through internal accruals.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹85 crore in a new integrated Alu-Zinc production line funded through internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of ₹40 crore comprises a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year and generate revenues from the last quarter onwards.
capex_expansion.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened to 4.40% in FY 2024-25 from 7.61% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment was described as fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The company's new colour coating manufacturing line is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
